name: travel-advisor-postman
description: Postman collection for the Travel Advisor API, run with Newman.

scripts.test: node node_modules/newman/bin/newman.js run TravelAdvisor.postman_collection.json -e local.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/newman-junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-skipSensitiveData
